title: Outcome-Definition Sensitivity Analysis: Information Systems methodology and reproducibility package
description: Development release candidate for a reusable Outcome-Definition Sensitivity Analysis methodology. The package formalises state spaces, alternative categorical outcome definitions, level and composition diagnostics, definition-specific association and ranking sensitivity and conservative claim-admissibility checks. It includes an aggregate-only organisational AI example and a deterministic methodological smoke simulation. This release candidate is not the final archival v3.0.0 release and does not claim a new DOI.
